thread:
Alex (prod): Quick sync — proposed MVP for Dedicated reserved pools + soft burst to unblock pilot customers (Finexa, HealthQ). Goal: pilot in ~6 weeks.
Rina (eng): Core MVP pieces: pool create/update APIs + console list, tenant-to-pool mapping, token-bucket quota with configurable burst, and spillover policy to shared capacity with rate limiting. No predictive autoscale for MVP.
Diego (sre): SLOs & safety: default eviction cap = 10% of pool during burst, baseline perf target 95p < 250ms for small models, must prevent noisy-tenant OOMs. Need chaos test for 3x peak.
Nina (sales): Customers are ok with soft-burst pilot if we provide clear failure modes and billing visibility. Finexa needs daily peak headroom; HealthQ requires documented data isolation and audit logs.
Jules (solutions): UX ask: onboarding opt-in toggle for pilot + clear note about overage billing. Also a CSV export for billing if console UI isn't ready.
Rina (eng): Enforcement plan: quota middleware checks commit and burst bucket. Fallback order: 1) pool, 2) shared (throttled), 3) reject with structured error referring to docs. We'll persist last-known quotas locally for 15m to survive control-plane blips.
Alex (prod): Acceptance criteria draft:
- APIs & console for pool ops and tenant assignment
- Quota model: monthly commit + default burst = 20% of commit (configurable)
- Billing: burst usage exported CSV + invoice line item for overage
- Metrics: per-tenant token use, spillover count, evictions, 95/99 latencies in Console
- Fail-open for 15m on control-plane loss
Diego (sre): Rollout guardrails: single region pilot, non-critical tenant subset, automated chaos + rollback within 5m if evictions exceed threshold.
Nina (sales): Timeline question — can we hit pilot in 6 weeks?
Rina (eng): 6 weeks if we reduce scope: skip billing UI and provide CSV export + manual invoices. Also cut predictive autoscale.
Alex (prod): Agreed. MVP = API + console pool ops, quota enforcement, soft burst + shared spillover, CSV billing export, metrics stream. Postpone billing UI and predictive autoscale to M2.
Jules (solutions): Customer acceptance tests to require:
- Finexa: run their eod peak in pool, confirm <2% error & documented fallback logs
- HealthQ: 24h separation test + audit log verification
infra-bot: Created pilot task #4872 in infra/pilots — runbook template added. Link: https://go.redwood/pilots/4872
Diego (sre): Security notes: KMS integration for model keys in private pools and RBAC for pool assignment. Also surface degradation reason in API errors.
Nina (sales): Need simple contract amendment: reserved pool + soft burst clause + overage rate. Legal to review.
Alex (prod): Decision items for Friday sync:
- finalize default burst % and eviction cap
- pilot customer list + signed TOC
- e2e test plan with perf targets
- CSV columns for billing export
Rina (eng): I'll open a PR with quota enforcement design and sample configs.
Jules (solutions): I'll draft runbooks and acceptance checklist.
Nina (sales): I'll confirm pilot windows with Finexa/HealthQ and start contract draft.
Diego (sre): I'll own chaos tests and SLO dashboard widgets.
Alex (prod): One more: do we offer strict-isolation opt-out?
Rina (eng): Yes as a paid opt-in. "Strict isolation" disables spillover and returns 429 if pool exhausted. Needs stronger capacity commit and adds ops burden.
Nina (sales): Customers needing strict isolation will accept premium pricing. Good to have in docs.
Alex (prod): OK locking scope. PRD + milestones incoming. Meeting Friday 10am. :white_check_mark:
